baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction قَوَارِيرَا مِن فِضَّةٍ joins the glass-vessel branch of ق ر ر to the silver-metal branch of ف ض ض, then follows them with emphatic تقدير.
baseline_models.mechanism: A fragile glass form and silver material are held together as a deliberately proportioned composite rather than as an accidental contradiction.

activation_trace.role: The glass-vessel image supplies the fragile container and anchors one material quality of the composite.
The white silver metal supplies the second material quality rather than merely a generic luxury marker.
Deliberate estimating and orderly preparation make the material conjunction an intentional design.

changed_reading.before: The ayah presents ornate silver cups.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents an intentionally engineered composite whose glasslike fragility and silver substance have been brought into exact relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا emphatically measures the feminine vessels, while the vessel root also carries an image of a single pour into a container.
baseline_models.mechanism: The vessels function as calibrated transfer units: containment, quantity, and fit are coordinated for a serving, although the focus alone does not identify who measures or for whom.

activation_trace.role: A one-discharge pour into a vessel supplies the transfer operation that the measured container regulates.
Measure reaching a thing's extent supplies the vessel's bounded quantity and capacity.
Fitting proportion turns bare quantity into a measure suited to its use.

changed_reading.before: The cups are uniformly decorative objects.
changed_reading.after: Each vessel is also a calibrated instrument whose amount and form are fitted to a serving.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The latent spaciousness of ف ض ض meets the constricting branch of ق د ر inside a glass container.
baseline_models.mechanism: Expansion is not canceled but given a usable boundary: a spreading abundance becomes available through exact containment.

activation_trace.role: The glass vessel supplies the boundary within which the opposed motions can be held.
Spacious looseness and spread supply an expansive pressure latent in the silver word.
Narrowing to a limited measure supplies the counter-motion that bounds the spread.

changed_reading.before: Exact measure suggests either neutral sizing or restricted provision.
changed_reading.after: Exact measure may be the boundary that lets abundance arrive in a stable, usable form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening creation sequence activates تقدير as form-making: measured proportion does not merely size the vessel but brings it into a fitted functional state.

activation_trace.role: Fitting proportion anchors the focus vessel as a form adjusted to its function.
Creation as measuring and proportioning supplies a context analogue for purposeful formation.
Making something enter a state supplies the transition from raw composition to usable capacity.

structural_cues: 76:2 moves from creation through composition to endowed hearing and sight, while 76:16 closes its object-description with an emphatic verb-plus-verbal-noun of measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation-as-measure and making-into-a-state; I transfer that functional sequence to the vessel. A live alternative is that the verbal echo marks only careful craftsmanship, not a creation analogy.

changed_reading.before: The measure is an external specification applied to a finished cup.
changed_reading.after: The measure participates in forming the vessel into the capacity and state appropriate to its purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mixture recurs from human origin to both described drinks, so the silver-glass conjunction becomes one instance of a surah-wide compositional grammar in which distinct materials generate a fitted whole.

activation_trace.role: The glass-vessel image supplies one distinct component and its fragile form.
Silver metal supplies the other distinct component of the focus conjunction.
Orderly proportioning makes the conjunction a designed composition rather than a loose juxtaposition.
Intermixture at human origin supplies the first context instance of identity emerging from composition.
Mixing one thing with another in the immediately following drink extends the compositional pattern across the focus.

structural_cues: The sequence places mixed origin at 76:2, a first drink-mixture at 76:5, the composite vessel at 76:16, and another drink-mixture at 76:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated mixture language and the focus's two-material construction; I infer a shared compositional logic. The alternative is that each mixture is local and the silver-glass phrase is simply a description of appearance or material.

changed_reading.before: Silver glass is a one-off marvelous material description.
changed_reading.after: Silver glass participates in a repeated pattern where carefully joined difference produces created form, drink, and vessel.

context_deltas.mechanism: Contextual abundance and effortless access revise the constricting branch of تقدير: the vessel's limit is an interface that converts an overflowing environment into a graspable portion, not evidence of scarcity.

activation_trace.role: Narrowing to a limited measure supplies the apparent restriction that context revises.
A single pour into a vessel supplies the local act by which flow becomes a serving.
A sudden abundant outflow supplies the larger hydraulic abundance surrounding the measured serving.
Making the difficult easy supplies accessibility as the governing mode of provision.
Ripeness and the ready time of picking supply abundance already adjusted for immediate use.

structural_cues: The spring is made to gush at 76:6, fruit is lowered and facilitated at 76:14, and only then are the vessels precisely measured at 76:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflowing flow, facilitated fruit, and exact containment; I infer that the boundary enables access rather than rations a shortage. A live alternative is that measure concerns visual proportion alone.

changed_reading.before: The exact amount may signal restricted provision.
changed_reading.after: The exact amount is a usable local form of an environment characterized by overflow and ready access.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who gave food while renouncing return are later encircled by service and given drink; precise vessel-fit therefore becomes relational hospitality that answers self-giving without turning it into a demanded exchange.

activation_trace.role: Fitting proportion anchors the possibility that each act of service is adjusted to its recipient.
Feeding another supplies the earlier outward movement of care that the later service answers.
Will and desire, explicitly denied as a demand for return, prevent the correspondence from becoming a bargained repayment.
Circulation around the recipients supplies an organized social delivery system for the vessels.
Giving drink supplies the culminating act of hospitality toward those who had given food.

structural_cues: 76:8-9 describes giving without requested recompense; 76:15-21 reverses the direction as vessels circulate around those same recipients and drink is given to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reversal from feeding to being served; I infer that exact fit personalizes that reversal while preserving its non-transactional character. The alternative is that the vessel measure has no social reference beyond uniform service.

changed_reading.before: The measured vessels display impersonal luxury or technical perfection.
changed_reading.after: Their precision can enact attentive hospitality, fitting service to recipients who had served others without asking for return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Explicit recompense for patience and acknowledgment of striving give physical proportion a moral resonance: the fitted vessel embodies correspondence, though not a calculable equivalence, between endured action and received good.

activation_trace.role: A measure reaching its proper extent supplies the tangible form of correspondence.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the explicit moral relation surrounding the vessel.
Holding oneself back from distress supplies the named action to which the surrounding reward responds.
Work and earned effort broaden the rewarded input from passive endurance to purposeful action.
Recognition of benefit supplies explicit acknowledgment that the striving has not been lost.

structural_cues: The focus vessel lies between recompense because of patience at 76:12 and the declaration of recompense and acknowledged striving at 76:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, patience, striving, and exact measure; I infer a non-numeric correspondence embodied by the vessel. The alternative is that the moral frame explains entitlement to the scene but not the vessel's dimensions.

changed_reading.before: The vessel is physically proportioned without reference to the recipients' history.
changed_reading.after: Its proportion can make the surrounding reward's responsive correspondence materially visible without implying a ledger-like exchange.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unresolved plural agency in قَدَّرُوهَا is nested inside a wider agency structure: the Lord gives the drink, and creaturely willing is placed under divine willing. The measurers act as agents of provision rather than independent owners of it.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity and control expose the agency question carried by the plural measuring verb.
Giving drink supplies the provision over which the later clause names the Lord as subject.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing identify the Lord's provision as the encompassing source of the service.
Will directed toward a thing supplies the explicit hierarchy in which human willing depends on divine willing.

structural_cues: 76:16 leaves the plural subject of measuring unnamed; 76:21 explicitly makes the Lord the giver of drink, and 76:30 subordinates human willing to divine willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unnamed plural agency, named divine giving, and nested willing; I apply that hierarchy to the measuring action. A live alternative is that attendants alone are the grammatical subject and no agency comment is intended.

changed_reading.before: The plural measurers autonomously determine the vessels.
changed_reading.after: Their exact calibration can be read as delegated responsiveness within a provision whose encompassing giver is the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later drink is not only consumed but described through a branch that can purify another; this lets the measured vessel function as a calibrated medium of transformation rather than quantity alone.

activation_trace.role: The glass vessel supplies the bounded medium through which the later drink is delivered.
Exact extent supplies the portion that can be read as calibrated for an effect.
Giving drink supplies the delivery action linking the vessel to its recipient.
Taking in liquid supplies ingestion rather than merely visual display.
That which purifies another supplies a possible transformative function for what the vessel contains.

structural_cues: The measured vessels at 76:16 are followed within the same serving scene by the Lord-given purifying drink at 76:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured delivery, ingestion, and a purifying quality; I supply the dosage-like arrow from exact portion to transformative effect. The alternative is that purity is simply a quality of the drink and unrelated to vessel measure.

changed_reading.before: The vessel contains a precisely sized luxury beverage.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its exact portion may mediate a drink whose purpose is to transform or purify the recipient.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates fracture and scattered-fragment branches beneath the literal silver and glass, then lets the nearby scattered pearls reverse damage into brilliance. It remains anchored in the focus's fragile glass and ف ض ض branch inventory, but downstream prose should present it only as a material-image resonance, not as the lexical meaning of silver.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fragile glass branch of قَوَارِيرَا and scattered-fragment branch latent in فِضَّةٍ stand together inside the precisely stabilized vessel.

activation_trace.role: Glass fragility supplies the possibility of breakage that the intact measured vessel suspends.
Scattered fragments supply a latent destructive version of dispersion within the silver root.
Shimmering pearl brilliance supplies a benign visual form for multiplicity.
Casting things in dispersion converts scattering from broken debris into the scene's luminous arrangement.

changed_reading.before: Fragile glass and silver are preserved from breakage by perfect manufacture.
changed_reading.after: The scene may more strangely transfigure the visual grammar of fracture: what could be fragments reappears nearby as an intact field of scattered brilliance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The body-vessel analogy is cross-domain and is not asserted by the ayah. It remains worth carrying because the focus branches include fullness settling in a body and fitting physical form, while 76:28 explicitly joins creation to tightened bodily articulation and replaceable form. Downstream prose should mark it as an analogy of constructed capacity, never identify people with cups.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines a containing vessel, bodily settling within ق ر ر, and physically fitted proportion within ق د ر.

activation_trace.role: Fullness and settling in a body supply the latent bridge from vessel containment to embodied capacity.
Fitting proportion and physically measured form anchor the analogy in the focus's repeated measure.
Tightening a bond supplies the operation that keeps a constructed whole coherent.
Tightly knit bodily structure and joints supply the explicit embodied container-side of the analogy.
Changing a thing's form supplies the contrast between stable capacity and replaceable configuration.

changed_reading.before: The ayah describes only exquisitely proportioned tableware.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the vessel can mirror created embodiment: a composite capacity held together, fitted to function, and dependent on the one who forms it.

strongest_changes: Repeated mixtures at 76:2, 76:5, and 76:17 turn silver-glass from a solitary marvel into part of a compositional grammar.
Gushing flow and facilitated fruit revise exact measure from possible scarcity into the usable boundary of abundance.
The reversal from feeding without return to circulating service makes precision relational hospitality rather than technical display.
Recompense, patience, and acknowledged striving let physical proportion embody responsive correspondence without requiring a numeric exchange.
Named divine giving and nested willing revise the anonymous plural measuring action toward delegated agency.
summary.what_was_special: This focus compresses material hybridity, fragile containment, expansive pressure, and emphatic measure into five words; the whole-surah packet activates that compression through creation, mixture, flow, service, reward, purification, and agency without forcing those mechanisms into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The subject of قَدَّرُوهَا and the beneficiary or standard of its measuring remain grammatically unresolved in the focus.
The relation between glass and silver may be literal composition, visual resemblance, or a conjunction of qualities; the packet does not settle it.
Moral correspondence is contextually strong but the claim that vessel dimensions embody it is reader-supplied.
The purifying-portion, scattered-brilliance, and embodied-vessel readings remain exploratory analogies rather than lexical conclusions.
